style: Warm acoustic ballad, soft piano, brushed drums, intimate male vocal, 70 BPM
lyrics:
[Verse]
Morning light across the harbour wall
Every boat is sleeping through the squall
The gulls are turning circles out at sea
And every quiet street belongs to me

[Chorus]
Stay with me until the water stills
Stay with me across the quiet hills
We will let the tide decide the way
Stay with me until the break of day

[Verse]
Salt along the railings on the pier
Someone left a lantern burning here
The fishing boats are rocking in the bay
And none of them are going out today

[Chorus]
Stay with me until the water stills
Stay with me across the quiet hills
We will let the tide decide the way
Stay with me until the break of day

[Outro]
Until the water stills
